maddeler.e:
اخترعن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَرَعْنَ (iḵtaraʕna) /ix.ta.raʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# اُخْتُرِعْنَ (uḵturiʕna) /ux.tu.riʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# اِخْتَرِعْنَ (iḵtariʕna) /ix.ta.riʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
